TS021 no-goto

Control flow is structured, so a reader follows it without a map of the labels.

languages: go
severity: error
default: on
group: stable
javascript: JavaScript has no goto; break and continue with a label are the only non-local jumps
odin: Odin has no goto; break and continue with a label are the only non-local jumps
python: Python has no goto; break, continue, and return are the only non-local jumps
rust: Rust has no goto; its loop labels break and continue to an enclosing loop only
typescript: TypeScript has no goto; break and continue with a label are the only non-local jumps
zig: Zig has no goto; its loop labels break and continue to an enclosing loop only

TigerStyle: "Use only very simple, explicit control flow for clarity."
NASA P10 Rule 1: "Restrict all code to very simple control flow constructs — do not use goto statements, setjmp or longjmp constructs, and direct or indirect recursion."
